title: Product Lead Credit Risk Data Ingestion
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€7.499,31 - €11.925,90
Are you passionate about data, risk management, and driving meaningful change? ING is looking for an ambitious, enthusiastic, and results-driven Product Lead to join the Credit Risk Tribe within COO Risk. If you're ready to take ownership, lead strategic initiatives, and make a real impact - then we are looking for you!
The opportunity in COO Risk sits right at the heart of the Bank’s operations. We translate our rather complex banking business exposures into impact on risk weighted assets and provisions in line with the constantly changing business desires and the latest regulatory requirements. We also provide important insights in NFR and Compliance topics and cater for corresponding regulatoryreporting needs. COO Risk delivers baseline and change activities for the Risk Organization with the purpose to drive our partners to maximize value in a safe & compliant environment. We play a critical role at ING and service all business lines, CROs and COOs of the Bank.
COO Risk is committed to take explicit ownership of the end-to-end execution of regulatory transformation initiatives. To deliver on these ambitious promises, we are looking for a Product lead who has an end-to-end strategic focus around our services and leads our squads in terms of clear prioritization, accountability and capabilities. The Product Lead is a position where all elements of a product come together, the what and the how, with an end-to-end transformation responsibility.
The roleAs a Product Lead you will manage a well-balanced team across multiple locations and between multiple squads centred around Data Ingestion for Vortex. This means being responsible for all data deliveries coming to Vortex, including accommodating changes and new source deliveries, maintaining the pre-processor functionality. Alignment of solutions across peers [MBB-3] within COOR and with business stakeholders across the bank. The main stakeholders sit within the newly created Credit Risk department within the CRO function.
You will cover all the Credit Risk work related to change [involvement in all Credit Risk related programs such as Basel IV] and operations [running daily and monthly reporting cycles] related to Vortex Data ingestion. This applies to Credit Risk data from all ING locations, both Retail and Wholesale Banking, including all regulatory and business change work which includes work onmultiple Credit Risk related applications (Vortex, SME Engine, Scoping Engine) under the current scope. The Product Lead position is based in NL.
Work environmentYou work not only on delivery and on how we run a product, but also on creating a vision on how we improve our services, how we manage the business value and how we increase collaboration across functions. You do that by steering three squads who work on a specific service by providing them with a strategic direction, by coaching them on the job, defining the product roadmap and bymanaging stakeholders. The people who work in the squads report to you, which means it is your job to empower them to thrive and perform at their best. You set direction, you help them to develop their craftsmanshipand you have continuous conversations about their career development.
As a Product Lead you report hierarchically to the Credit Risk Tribe Lead. Within the Tribe, we do not solely focus on transformation, also ensuring all data is processed as per the agreed timelines is at the core what we do. By doing so, we do ensure that every colleague has insights in their daily, monthly, or quarterly data in a timely manner. Consequently, we monitor the timeline of internal and external reporting and apply the correct standards for data quality to ourstakeholders.
Roles and responsibilitiesAs a Product Lead, you:
Actively manage all internal parties and projects to successfully deliver upon the initiatives within the Data Ingestion area
Take ownership of a sizable number of explicit regulatory transformation initiatives
Be the hierarchical manager of a team of up to 10 people
Be able to work in a collaborative and highly complex setting
Be able to influence the level playing field of your team including teams outside of COO Risk
Able to take responsibility, steer strategy and realisations based on facts and data; managerial courage to question and make decisions for highly complex issues
Build the craftsmanship of the employees in the team in line with the strategy of the Credit Risk Tribe
Ensure compliance with relevant regulation and internal/external requirements
How to succeedWe are looking for a leader who takes things on and makes things happen; who is passionate about helping others to be successful; and has a knack for always being a step ahead. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.
As a Product Lead, you will also need to be able to:
Drive and manage large change programs in an international context and master complex financial content
Lead and deliver complex (multi-year) change programs on program level – covering multiple countries / functional departments
Communicate effectively to senior management, in which you can adapt your style and the content of your communication to the needs of others you work with. You always pay attention to the input and opinions of others
Be organizational savvy, you maneuver easily through complex policies, processes and people-related organizational dynamics across ING
Look ahead, you show a strategic mindset and you find future opportunities which you can translate into concrete strategies
Be tech savvy, where you anticipate and leverage innovations in digital and technical applications that make ING commercially stronger and more effective
Build an effective team, that has diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals
People management: being responsible for the inflow, progression, and outflow of employees of ‘your’ teams and playing an active role in the well-being and engagement of employees and the development of their craftsmanship
Required skills and experiences
A university degree, preferably a Master’s.
10+ years of experience in banking, IT, and/or credit risk systems and processes.
6–10 years of hands‑on experience in Credit Risk and IT, with strong functional knowledge.
3–6 years of experience planning work, managing resources, and delivering key objectives.
Experience working in a complex, international environment with many stakeholders.
Strong background in leading large change or transformation projects.
3–6 years of exposure to risk-related topics and initiatives.
Experience creating strategies and policies for medium- and long‑term goals.
A proven track record in process management, backlog management, and resource planning.
A proactive, “can‑do” mindset — someone who is resourceful and goes the extra mile.
Excellent command of English.
Rewards and benefitsWe want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.Find out more about our employment conditions.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
25-28 vacation days depending on contract
25-28 vacation days depending on contract
Personal growth with many opportunities to develop yourself further
A team of passionate professionals committed to data and risk
Personal growth & challenging work with endless opportunities to realize your ambitions
An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavours
A progressive and agile way of working, where new ideas are valued ahead of convention and furthermore, within the COO Risk organization you can count on a range of opportunities to invest in your personal and professional growth.
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
